title: A protocol for high-throughput screening for immunomodulatory compounds using human primary cells
protocol: Fully thaw autologous platelet poor plasma (PPP) in a 15 mL tube in a 37°C water bath.
Centrifuge the thawed plasma at 3000 g for 8 minutes (high acceleration / medium deceleration).
Transfer supernatant of the centrifuged plasma to new 15 mL tube under sterile conditions.
Thaw human PBMCs in a 37°C water bath.
Transfer 1 mL of the thawed PBMC from its 2 mL cryotube to a new 50 mL tube under sterile conditions.
Add 2 mL of autologous PPP to collect any remaining cells on the side of the cryotube and transfer this PPP to the 50 mL tube.
Add 27 mL of Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM) to the PBMC/plasma mixture in the 50 mL tube.
Centrifuge cells at 500 g for 10 min with high acceleration and medium deceleration.
Create a freshly prepared media composition of 50 mL with 10% autologous PPP and 90% DMEM.
Discard supernatant from centrifuged cells and resuspend cell pellet with 10 mL of media.
Dilute samples 1:10 in trypan blue (10 μL cells + 90 μL 0.4% trypan blue) and count cells.
Dilute cells to 1.67 e6 cells/mL, which will allow distribution of 50,000 cells/well.
Keep cells on ice until ready for use.
Wash a standard-bore Combi cassette with 50 mL of sterile water followed by a 50 mL ethanol wash and another wash with 50 mL of sterile water using the Multidrop™ Combi Reagent Dispenser.
Prime approximately 10–15 mL of the cell suspension through the manifold.
Lightly agitate the cell suspension prior to dispensing cells to each microplate.
Dispense 30 μL per well to 384-well Corning 3656 microplates on the low-speed setting.
Wash the Combi cassette with 50 mL of St. H2O.
Wash the Combi cassette with 50 mL EtOH.
Wash the Combi cassette with 50 mL of St. H2O using the combi reagent dispenser.
Transfer 100 nL of compound from source library plates into the destination cell plates using the Seiko Compound Pin Transfer Workstation.
Test each library plate over four biological replicates with two technical replicates per donor.
Add 5 μL of positive and negative controls to each plate in designated wells using a multichannel pipette.
Incubate the plate for 72 hours in a 37°C, 5% CO2 humidified incubator.
Fix cells to limit degradation and preserve protein structures.
Centrifuge plate at 500 g for 10 minutes (9 g acceleration, 7 g deceleration).
Aspirate 2 μL of supernatant from each well on the cell plate.
Dispense 2 μL of supernatant into a labeled PerkinElmer AlphaPlate-384.
Repeat the 2 μL transfer process into another labeled AlphaPlate.
Replace the cover on the cell plate and store at 4°C.
Seal the two AlphaPlates with aluminum seals and store overnight at -80°C.
Remove the cell plate from 4°C storage and centrifuge at 700 g for 10 minutes.
Flick the supernatant off only once after centrifugation to prevent excessive cell loss.
Wash a standard-bore Combi cassette with 50 mL of St. H2O.
Wash the Combi cassette with 50 mL EtOH.
Wash the Combi cassette with 50 mL of St. H2O.
Dilute 500 mM EDTA with PBS to generate a 250 mM stock of EDTA.
Keep the 250 mM EDTA solution on ice.
Prime approximately 10–15 mL of the 250 mM EDTA through the manifold.
Dispense 20 μL of EDTA per well.
Wash the standard tube cassette with 50 mL distilled water.
Wash the standard tube cassette with 50 mL ethanol.
Wash the standard tube cassette with another 50 mL distilled water using the Combi.
Shake covered cell plate at 700 rpm for 10 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge plate at 750 g for 10 min (9 g acceleration, 7 g deceleration) at room temperature.
Dilute antibody cocktail 1:200 in dPBS by volume.
Prepare 2 mL of cocktail per plate with 10–15 mL excess for priming and deadweight loss.
Attach and wash a small-bore Combi cassette with 30 mL St. H2O.
Wash the small-bore Combi cassette with 30 mL EtOH.
Wash the small-bore Combi cassette with another 30 mL St. H2O using the Combi.
Prime approximately 5–10 mL of the antibody solution through the cassette.
Dispense 5 μL of antibody solution per well.
Incubate cell plate at 4°C for 30 min during antibody incubation.
Attach and wash a standard-bore Combi cassette with 50 mL St. H2O.
Wash the standard-bore Combi cassette with 50 mL EtOH.
Wash the standard-bore Combi cassette with another 50 mL St. H2O using the Combi.
Prime approximately 10–15 mL of PBS through the cassette.
Dispense 40 μL of PBS per well.
Centrifuge plate at 750 g for 10 min (9/7 g acceleration and deceleration).
Wash the standard-bore Combi cassette with 50 mL of St. H2O.
Wash the standard-bore Combi cassette with 50 mL of EtOH.
Wash the standard-bore Combi cassette with 50 mL of St. H2O.
While plate is centrifuged, dilute 16% PFA to 1% PFA in dPBS.
Calculate for 10 mL per plate and an excess 10-15 mL for priming and deadweight loss.
Flick the supernatant off when plate finishes centrifugation.
Prime approximately 10 mL of 1% PFA through the cassette.
Dispense 25 μL of 1% PFA per well.
Incubate the cell plate at 4°C during cell fixation.
Retrieve cell plates from 4°C storage.
Centrifuge the plates at 750 g for 10 minutes (9/7 g acceleration and deceleration).
Flick off the supernatant when the centrifugation is complete.
Wash a standard-bore Combi cassette with 50 mL of sterile water, followed by a 50 mL EtOH wash, and another 50 mL of sterile water using the Combi.
Prime approximately 10 mL of PBS through the cassette.
Dispense 25 μL of PBS per well using the Combi.
Centrifuge the plates at 750 g for 10 minutes (9/7 g acceleration and deceleration).
Flick off the supernatant when the centrifugation is complete.
Using the Combi, dispense 20 μL of PBS per well.
Wash the standard-bore Combi cassette with 50 mL of sterile water, followed by a 50 mL EtOH wash, and another 50 mL of sterile water using the Combi.
Assess plates on the iQue to collect flow cytometry results.
Run each cell plate on the IQue Flow Cytometer in less than an hour.
Alternatively, use other flow cytometers for flow collection periods that may be longer.
Conduct AlphaLISA assays to measure cytokine induction within 2.5 hours.
Detect TNF-α, IFN-λ, and IL-10 secretion to capture innate immune responses.
Adapt the panel of cytokines to fit the focus of other screening efforts.
Prepare AlphaLISA buffers and the AlphaLISA Acceptor beads + Biotinylated Antibody mixtures for each cytokine of interest.
Prepare 15 mL of extra reagent for priming on the Combi as well as potential deadweight volume loss.
Reconstitute AlphaLISA standards in 100 μL of MilliQ water and prepare standard dilutions according to the protocol.
Manually add 2 μL of standards to a new AlphaPlate using a multichannel pipette.
Retrieve AlphaPlates with supernatant from −80°C storage and remove aluminum seal.

Wash a small-bore Combi cassette with 30 mL St. H2O, followed by a 30 mL EtOH wash, and 30 mL St. H2O wash using the Combi.Prime approximately 10 mL of the Acceptor beads+ Biotinylated Antibody mixture through the cassette.
Add 8 μL per well for each cytokine/AlphaLISA kit of interest.
Allow the AlphaPlates to incubate at room temperature for an hour in the dark without sealing the plates.
Wash a different small-bore Combi cassette with 30 mL St. H2O, followed by a 30 mL EtOH wash, and 30 mL St. H2O wash using the Combi.
Prepare Streptavidin Donor Beads for each cytokine of interest in the dark as described in their published protocols.
Prime approximately 5–10 mL of donor beads through the cassette.
Add 10 μL per well of prepared donor beads.
Allow the AlphaPlates to incubate at room temperature in the dark for 30 min.
Quantitate fluorescent signal in each well using the EnVision to determine cytokine levels in the supernatant.
